protocol.representation: Global source mean or four deterministic FPS source centers; Gaussian Taylor degrees2/3/4. Uncorrected kernel expansion, no diagonal correction.
protocol.captures: Read-only copies of exact packed24core675 congruence product inputs under common hoisted kernel. First/middle/last selected AFTER run, zero-based indices. Dense captures/reference computations are free offline oracle, no native timing/memory evidence.
protocol.bound: norm(abs(K-Kp) @ abs(v)) is an offline oracle triangle bound, not a cheap computable certificate.
protocol.work: Feature visits and pair counts are heterogeneous work proxies, not equivalent FLOPs/runtime. Partition, source coordinate scaling, feature generation costs and scratch excluded. Moments can stream one cluster. No fixed-memory proof.
protocol.scope: Four development hard cases only, not small-n/held-out validation or a solver policy.
